note: Modal list prices and limits as published on the cited pages on the access date. Prices change; re-check https://modal.com/pricing before any spend. Fields marked status 'assumption' or 'unverified' are not published figures.

gpu_memory_gb.source: https://modal.com/docs/guide/gpu (H200 141 GB, A100 40/80 GB, L40S 48 GB, A10 4 x 24 = 96 GB); L4 24 GB from https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/l4/; null = not checked

cpu_note: Per physical core (2 vCPU equivalent); minimum 0.125 cores per container; billed on the higher of requested and used.
mem_note: Minimum 128 MiB per container; billed on the higher of requested and used.
sandbox_note: Modal Sandbox and Notebooks CPU and memory rates (about 3x the Function rates). Run batch jobs as Functions, not Notebooks.
volume_note: Pricing page: Volumes $0.09/GiB/mo, includes 1 TiB/mo free. Usage is snapshotted daily; deleted data may be billed for up to four days (volumes guide).
egress_note: Charged from 2026-10-01. Outbound traffic from containers counts; reads and writes to Modal Volumes do not; downloads into a container are ingress.
region_note: Applied to all resources of a Function that sets region=. Broad example 'us', narrow example 'us-west'. Leave region unset to pay base price.
nonpreemptible_note: nonpreemptible=True multiplies CPU and memory list price by 3; it is not supported for GPU Functions, so GPU work is always preemptible and needs checkpoints.
billing_granularity: Per second, no minimum usage-time increments (billing guide). Billed during application load time, while processing inputs, and during the idle window before scale-down (default 60 s; scaledown_window configurable from 2 s to 20 min).

plans.note: null = unlimited or custom on the pricing page. Included compute covers Functions, Sandboxes and Notebooks (CPU, memory, GPU); not Shared Endpoints (per token).

max_gpus_per_container.note: More than 2 GPUs per container usually means longer waits. Multi-node is private beta. RTX-PRO-6000 limit not stated on the guide.

credit_programs.academic: Graduate students, labs and researchers: up to $10k free compute credits (https://modal.com/pricing, https://modal.com/academics).
credit_programs.startup: One-time credits for VC-backed startups (partner VC or more than $1m raised) (https://modal.com/startups).
credit_programs.cloud_credits: AWS, GCP and Azure credits cannot be applied (pricing FAQ).

speed_vs_a100_80gb.note: Relative CNN training throughput, A100 80GB SXM4 = 1.0. Used only to compare cost per unit of work. Not measured on ink models.

H100.source: Lambda PyTorch fp16 training throughput, SSD 782 vs 458 and ResNet-50 2616 vs 1582 img/s (https://github.com/lambdal/deeplearning-benchmark/blob/master/pytorch/pytorch-train-throughput-fp16.csv); MLPerf Training 3D U-Net, Dell 8 x H100 7.6 min vs 8 x A100 11.0 min (https://silvertonconsulting.com/2023/07/12/mlperf-results-show-h100-v-a100-and-v-habana-gaudi2-gpus/)

A100-40GB.source: Lambda fp16 CSV, A100 40GB PCIe SSD 395 and ResNet-50 1396 img/s; Modal does not state the 40 GB form factor

L40S.source: Lambda fp16 CSV, RTX 6000 Ada (same AD102 chip family as L40S) SSD 341 and ResNet-50 1146 img/s; L40S itself not in the table

A10.source: Lambda fp16 CSV, LambdaCloud A10 SSD 174 and ResNet-50 638 img/s

H200.source: No comparable training benchmark found; Modal says an H100 request may be upgraded to an H200 at H100 price (gpu guide)

L4.source: NVIDIA lists 300 GB/s memory bandwidth and 30.3 FP32 TFLOPS (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/l4/); no comparable training benchmark found

alternatives.note: On-demand list prices per GPU hour on the access date. Pods and instances bill while running even when idle; Modal bills per second and scales to zero.

runpod_pods.storage: network volume $0.07/GB/mo under 1 TB; pod volume disk $0.10/GB/mo running, $0.20 idle

vast_ai_snapshot.source: Public offers API https://console.vast.ai/api/v0/bundles/ (on-demand, 1 GPU, rentable), queried 2026-10-07 19:30 UTC; marketplace prices move by the hour and host reliability varies

lightning_ai.source: Third-party capture of lightning.ai/pricing dated 2026-09-21 (https://www.usagepricing.com/blueprint/lightning-ai); the official page renders by script and was not read directly
lightning_ai.free: 5 credits at signup plus 25 after adding a card, expire after 12 months (https://api.lightning.ai/pricing/)

colab.cu_source: Community measurement, March 2026 (http://mccormickml.com/2024/04/23/colab-gpus-features-and-pricing/); Google does not publish rates; GPU type is not guaranteed; H100 limited to Pro+ (https://github.com/googlecolab/colabtools/issues/6076)

kaggle.note: Floating weekly quota, 30 h or sometimes more; queues when busy; 12 h session limit per a third-party summary of the docs (https://ai-deals.rockpool.cc/offer-kaggle-notebooks-free-gpu-tpu-quota)
